note: City of Fairbury park ~5 mi south of town with spring-fed lakes. The lakeside sites (1-20, 22-24) are paved diagonal pads in a lot along the south shore of the west lake, reservation required. The upper sites (25-42) sit in the trees uphill and are first come, pay at the box. Electricity year-round, water April 15 - October 15. The free dump station is at Fairbury City Park in town, on the same water schedule. Trout-stocked center lake, disc golf. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $20, booking (city's Rec1 catalog, 1-year window, 14 nights, upper sites first come), 42 sites incl. host, 30/50 A + water, showers, dump off-site, all now manual from the city page. Lakes are ~6-7.7 acres (above the pond line). Waterfront lead DOWN lakefront -> lakeview: the shore road runs between the lakeside pads and the lake. Pin ~425 m off, on the road between the two eastern lakes.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (down, lakefront -> lakeview): the reservable lakeside sites 1-20 are paved diagonal pull-in pads in a lot south of the WEST lake. On NAIP (0.4 m/px), the north row's pad ends are ~10-20 m from the water, but the park's gravel shore road runs between the pads and a thin treed/grass bank. That is the campground's own loop road, which blocks on-water, so lakeview at best. Sites 22-24 (beside host site 21 near the message center, west of the center lake) are ~35-45 m from the center lake across the access road and walkway. The upper sites 25-42 are in trees ~100 m+ uphill (not waterfront). Lake areas by NIR flood-fill: west lake (beside sites 1-20) ~6.0 acres, center lake ~7.2 acres, east lake ~5.9-7.7 acres. All are above the ~5-acre pond line, so a lake view stands. The stored evidence is only the commit pointer 9af42bc.

PIN (move proposed): stored 40.12950,-97.20180 is on the park road between the center and east lakes, ~425 m east of the lakeside campsite lot. Suggest 40.1305,-97.2068 (centre of the lakeside pads; upper sites are ~100-150 m south of there).
WEBSITE: keep both lines. The Rec1 catalog is the city's booking engine (JavaScript-only, so prices weren't read there). Phone 402-729-2476 is the city office on the page footer, confirmed.

RATE: the city's $20 is undated text, but the page was edited May 2024 or later (its QR image is labelled '5.6.24'). Third-party figures run higher: a search summary gives a Campendium July 2025 report of $23 (likely with tax and fees) and The Dyrt/RoverPass at $25. Neither is from the operator, so $20 stands.
